## GoreeCloud UI scope

Describe why the visual, semantic or interaction change is necessary and which token/component contract it updates.

## Design and engineering checklist

- [ ] The change follows current GoreeCloud UI authority and does not misrepresent unimplemented consumer migrations.
- [ ] Canvas / Surface / Lens hierarchy, readable typography and purposeful depth are preserved.
- [ ] Iris, Lagoon, Ember and Moss (light and dark) were reviewed as appropriate.
- [ ] Keyboard focus, native semantics, error/disabled/loading states and touch ergonomics considered.
- [ ] Narrow/wide layouts, zoom, RTL, reduced motion, forced color and reduced transparency reviewed.
- [ ] Machine-readable registry and migration guidance updated if an API changes.
- [ ] No third-party copyrighted icon/font/asset copied without permission and attribution.
- [ ] Relevant tests, visual evidence, CI checks and unverified platforms are recorded.

## Verification and open items

Record exact commands, outputs, screenshots, manual review gaps and rollback considerations here.
